policy.whitespace: Trim leading/trailing whitespace in every cell.
policy.blanks: Convert case-insensitive N/A, NA, NULL, and NONE to empty.
policy.dedupe: Keep the first exact normalized non-blank match on the selected key; preserve all-blank keys; do not fuzzy-match or guess.
policy.formula_safety: Flag cells beginning with =, +, -, or @ for review; preserve their values instead of guessing intent.
